create_BaseTrainer: create a BaseTrainer instance with a model, loss functions, datasets, and training configuration
run_BaseTrainer_train: run the BaseTrainer train method to train a model for a specified number of epochs
test_BaseTrainer__train_epoch: test the BaseTrainer _train_epoch method to train a single epoch on a dataset

refactor_BaseTrainer__train_batch: refactor the BaseTrainer _train_batch method to customize gradient computation and optimizer steps
